description.text: Computer Science and Technology program began enrollment in 1999.Through years of construction and development, it isbecomingone of the majorswith themost solid educational foundationand achievement. This programwaslisted as the provincialkey constructionspecialty in 2007, as the provincialnew characteristicspecialtyin 2014, and as the provincialcharacteristicspecialty in 2017.The discipline of Computer ScienceandTechnology is theprovincial keydisciplineand theprovincialfirst-class discipline(ClassB),which owns theKey Laboratory of Forestry Intelligent Monitoring and Information Technologyof Zhejiang Province. In the past years, the program has adopted various strategies to educate featured talents and to promote students' practical capability and cultivating innovation and entrepreneurship by means of academic competitions.According to MyCOS survey, graduates of this major have ranked the top in terms of satisfaction, employment salary and employment competitiveness in recent years.Featured in the combination of information technology and agriculture forestry, the professional education of the program is unique. First, the program takes advantage of the forestry industry to carry out specialty training. The program also established two specialties, which are in agriculture forestry information technology and embedded IOT systems, respectively, to improve the training system. Second, the program developed featured courses and jointly founded the outstanding engineers innovative experimental class with Tarena Education Group. Third, the program developed diversified practice bases to promote the integration of government, industry, academia and research. Accordingly, multiple on-campus platforms for innovation and entrepreneurship were established; a number of stable off-campus training bases were formed under cooperation with well-known IT enterprises. The introduction of certification exammechanism directly connects the program to the job market. The program cultivates innovation and entrepreneurship by means of academic competitions. Taking advantage of the school's innovative platforms, the program highly encourages students to participate in academic competitions.Graduates of the program willhave the ability to adapt to the development of society, economy and information technology industry,alsohave good humanistic qualities, moral quality and communication skills, and have strong engineering practicecapability, innovationspiritand competitiveness.The program expects the graduates achieve the following goals in5years after graduation:1. An ability of using the professional knowledge and technology to design computer software and hardware systems, especially solutions for embedded and agriculture and forestryinformatizationrelated systems, and an ability to successfully implement the designed solutions;2. An ability to become a core member or a leader of a team, and to effectively make contributions;3.Strong project management and communication skills, good professional cultivation and moral standards, professional competitiveness in related fields;4.An ability to improve his/her knowledge and capability through further education or lifelong learning;5.Familiar with the politics, economy and culture of contemporary China, able to participate in and promote the friendly exchanges and cooperation between China and their host countries.

duration.text: The Computer Science and Technology at Zhejiang Agriculture and Forestry University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: For the students who have never studied in China：1.The Photocopy of Passport (the main page and the page with signature) 2.Translated and notarized copy of final degree or diploma and transcript3.Language proficiency certificate4.Non-criminal record or Chinese/English-translated document with an official stamp.5.Other certificates or documents 6.Foreigner physical examination form: bearing the stamp of the hospital. Physical examination results are valid for 6 months7.Application Form For School8.Family Information Form9.Financial Income Statement10.A Short Video of Self Introduction11.Commitment without Drug Use History 12.Photo（format: JPG format, color, 2-inch ID photo, white background , the head occupies 2/3 of the photo, no less than 320 * 240 pixels, aspect ratio is 4: 3, the size is 100-500KB.）For the transferred students who have already studied in China：1.The Photocopy of Passport (the main page and the page with signature) and Visa page2.Translated and notarized copy of final degree or diploma and transcript3.Last semester transcript in the previous school4.Language proficiency certificate5.Non-criminal record or Chinese/English-translated document with an official stamp.6.Transfer letter from last school include the attendance and performance 7.certificate of verification from Entry-Exit inspection and Quarantine within 6 months8.Application Form For School9.Family Information Form10. Financial Income Statement11.A Short Video of Self Introduction12.Commitment without Drug Use History 13.Photo（format: JPG format, color, 2-inch ID photo, white background , the head occupies 2/3 of the photo, no less than 320 * 240 pixels, aspect ratio is 4: 3, the size is 100-500KB.）

requirements.text: 1. Applicants should be aged between 18 and 282.Applicant should be non-Chinese citizens with valid regular foreign passport and be friendly to China; *Residents of China who have emigrated to a foreign country and who are now applying to study in China as international students must have held a valid foreign passport for at least 4 years, and must have actually resided in a foreign country for at least 2 years in the past 4 years. (9 months of residence in a foreign country may count as a full year. The dates of the entry and exit stamps in the passport will be followed in the determination of the actual length of foreign residence).
